layout.arrangement: Minimal section-divider slide: a large light-gray content panel with a thin dark-red border fills almost the entire slide on a white background; the two-line title is centered horizontally and vertically inside the panel; a small yellow circular slide-number badge '58' sits at the panel's top-right corner; a solid black horizontal strip runs along the very bottom edge of the slide, slightly wider than the gray panel.

regions.name: Gray content panel
regions.position: center, approx 6% to 94% width, 8% to 95% height
regions.content: Empty light-gray rectangle with thin dark-red border; contains only the centered title and the slide-number badge

regions.name: Title block
regions.position: center, approx 20% to 75% width, 42% to 60% height
regions.content: Two centered lines of large bold dark-red text: 'Transformer Encoder' / 'as a Classifier'; a small black cursor/pointer icon appears immediately after the word 'Classifier'

regions.name: Slide-number badge
regions.position: top-right, approx 89% to 94% width, 10% to 17% height
regions.content: Yellow circle with purple/indigo outline containing the number '58' in small dark text

regions.name: Bottom black bar
regions.position: bottom, approx 4% to 96% width, 95% to 100% height
regions.content: Solid black horizontal strip along the bottom edge, extending slightly beyond the gray panel on both sides

layout.hierarchy: The dark-red bold title is by far the dominant element (largest size and strongest color contrast against the pale gray panel); the slide-number badge is a small secondary accent; the black bottom bar is a low-attention framing element; the rest of the panel is intentionally empty whitespace.

visual_elements.description: Large light-gray rectangle (the slide content panel) with a thin (~2px) dark-red/maroon border, covering nearly the whole slide area; no fill texture or gradient
visual_elements.position: center, spanning approx 6%-94% width and 8%-95% height

visual_elements.description: Circular slide-number badge: yellow-filled circle with a medium purple/indigo outline, containing the number '58' in small dark sans-serif text, centered in the circle
visual_elements.position: top-right corner inside the gray panel, approx x 90%, y 13%

visual_elements.description: Small black mouse-pointer/cursor icon (likely the presenter's pointer captured in the video frame) positioned immediately to the right of the word 'Classifier', slightly above the text baseline
visual_elements.position: center-right of title block, approx x 67%, y 52%

visual_elements.description: Solid black horizontal bar/strip along the bottom edge of the slide, uniform height, no text or markings

imagery: Small black mouse-cursor/pointer icon just after the word 'Classifier' — appears to be a screen-capture artifact of the presenter's cursor rather than an intentional graphic; style: simple solid black arrow/pen-nib shape
typography_notes: Title is a bold sans-serif (Arial/Helvetica-like), set on two centered lines ('Transformer Encoder' / 'as a Classifier'), sentence case with capitalized keywords, roughly 40pt equivalent — very large relative to the slide. No body text, bullets, or italics anywhere. Slide number '58' is small dark sans-serif inside the badge. No numbered bullets; no all-caps styling.
animation_state: Static section-title slide with no build state; no bullets to reveal. The small cursor icon near the title suggests the video frame caught the presenter's mouse pointer mid-move — it is not a slide element and should be omitted (or optionally noted) in recreation.
recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). 2. Draw a rectangle covering approx 6%-94% width and 8%-95% height; fill light gray (#E9E9E7); border: thin (~1.5pt) solid dark red (#8B1A1A). 3. Insert a text box centered horizontally within the panel, vertically centered slightly above middle; type two centered lines: 'Transformer Encoder' (line 1) and 'as a Classifier' (line 2); font: Arial Bold (or similar sans-serif), approx 40pt, color firebrick red (#B22222). 4. In the panel's top-right corner (approx 90% width, 13% height), draw a circle approx 0.5" diameter: fill yellow (#F5F27D), outline purple/indigo (#6C5CE7) ~1.5pt; add text '58' centered inside, approx 12pt, dark gray (#333333). 5. Along the bottom edge of the slide, draw a solid black (#000000) rectangle approx 4%-96% width and 4%-5% height (a thin strip slightly wider than the gray panel). 6. Leave all remaining space empty — no bullets, images, or footer text. 7. Do not include the small cursor icon visible near 'Classifier' (it is a video-capture artifact of the presenter's pointer).
